intro.summary: St Homobonus was a 12th-century Italian layman and merchant known for honest trade, charity to the poor, and devotion to prayer.

blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Beloved and charitable Saint Homobonus, your honesty and good will served your community and the Lord well. Help me follow your example, and not give in to temptations of greed and shortcuts that wound others. I ask for guidance in my work and business, so that I may prosper by choosing virtue over avarice.

Amen. O Lord, You who inspired Saint Homobonus with such zeal for his profession as a tailor, grant that he may guard us, that we may not desire riches. Rather, help us to remember that, as Scripture tells us, it will not be easy for a rich man to enter heaven. And so, may we be always content with the bare necessities of life, and not desire the love of money. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saint Homobonus, pray for us. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
